mapper.sql: id, device_id, tag_key, tag_value, value_type, updated_at
mapper.select: select from pep_domain.device_tag where device_id = #{deviceId} order by tag_key
mapper.insert: insert into pep_domain.device_tag (device_id, tag_key, tag_value, value_type, updated_at) values (#{deviceId}, #{tagKey}, #{tagValue}, #{valueType}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update pep_domain.device_tag set device_id = #{deviceId}, tag_key = #{tagKey}, tag_value = #{tagValue}, value_type = #{valueType}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
